<!--
Use this template to propose a new skill. Proposals help us evaluate scope,
avoid duplication, and confirm that adequate sources exist before drafting.
New skills must follow SKILL-TEMPLATE.md and the guidance in CONTRIBUTING.md.
-->

<!-- Suggested folder/skill name, e.g. avian-triage. Lowercase, hyphenated. -->

<!-- Which existing category does this belong to, or is a new one needed?
Current categories: clinical, pharma, species, literature, safety, databases. -->


## Species scope

<!-- Which species does this skill cover? Is it species-specific, multi-species,

<!-- What clinical or workflow gap does this fill? Who benefits, and how does it

<!-- List the primary references you would base the skill on: textbooks (with

<!-- Example prompts the skill should handle, related skills, or anything else. -->
